overview: The classic Nilgiri hill stations: Ooty with its lake, botanical garden and cool air, and quieter Coonoor with tea estates and the UNESCO toy train. Reachable by road or train from Chennai.
fit: Very kid-friendly: toy train, boating, gardens and horse rides. Pack warm clothes.
season: March to June is the main season (15–25°C); April–May is crowded with summer holidays. October is lovely; December–February is chilly (can touch 0°C at night). Monsoon June–September.

gettingThere.detail: Nilgiri Express Chennai to Mettupalayam overnight, then the toy train up to Coonoor/Ooty
Chennai to Coimbatore, then 3 hr drive
Chennai to Ooty via Salem and Mettupalayam

gettingAround: Hire a cab locally. Ooty town traffic is heavy in season; walk where you can. Tourist vehicles need an e-pass in peak season.

todo.title: Thread Garden / Wax museum

stay.why: Resorts with views between the two

foodTips: Plenty of South Indian vegetarian food; easy for the kids.
save: Avoid the April–May rush; go in March or October
Book the toy train early on IRCTC
Stay in Coonoor for better value and fewer crowds
safety: Hairpin roads: hire an experienced hill driver
Horse rides at the lake: choose a handler who walks alongside
health: Layers for cold mornings and nights
Motion sickness medicine for the ghat road
kids: The toy train is the highlight; ride at least one way
Carry snacks: the toy train has limited food
Plan indoor backups for misty afternoons

days.plan: Overnight train to Mettupalayam; toy train to Coonoor; Sim's Park
Dolphin's Nose, tea factory, drive to Ooty
Pykara in the morning; drive down and head home
